def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct ids, identical on every run for the same seed.

    Ids are consecutive from seed, so the result depends only on n and seed.
    """
    pre n >= 0
    pre seed >= 0
    pre seed <= 1000000000000
    pre n <= 1000000000
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
    ex make_ids(3, 5) == [5, 6, 7]
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(seed + i)
    return out
